messages:
Sam (CSM): Quick FYI — weekly health snapshot for Marinex: hosted usage vs commit shows an unexpected +48% token burn this week. billing-bot alert below. Latency unchanged (p50 ~ 120ms) but error rate on /v1/chat up +0.6%. @Rina can you take point? :eyes:

billing-bot: Automated billing alert
Customer: Marinex
Period: 2026-03-17 to 2026-03-23
Committed: $12,000
Consumed (hosted): $17,760 (+48%)
Anomaly flags: spend_exceed_commit, usage_pattern_spike
Top routes: /v1/chat (78% tokens), /v1/embeddings (12%)
Top model: open-llama-7b-quant
Details: https://redwood.internal/billing/alert/12345

Rina (Account Eng): Looking into it now. Pulling per-route token hist and recent deployment diffs.

Nate (CS Ops): I see a canary-like config change pushed last Fri — batch_size bumped to 64 in an onboarding template? Hosted customers shouldn't get that. @Product Analytics can you surface per-hour token rate and top prompts?

Product Analytics: Query posted: `SELECT hour, SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE customer='marinex' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 48;`
Preview: spike begins Fri 02:00 UTC, sustained ~14h, peak +220% hour-over-hour.

Rina (Account Eng): Found three keys labeled `marinex-integration` created yesterday by their test harness; they appear to stream many parallel sessions. Recommending revoke two and apply token quota on the remaining.

Sam (CSM): Can you revoke now and confirm? Also schedule an enablement call to go over safe test practices (prefix caching, batching, streaming limits). This could be a renewal risk if they blow through commit — flag FinOps.

Rina (Account Eng): Revoked two keys. Applied temporary quota 200k tokens/hr on remaining key and rate-limited streaming concurrency. Monitoring now.

billing-bot: Update: spend delta down to +12% vs commit within 2h after action. Continuing to watch; will send another update in 4h.

Nate (CS Ops): Action items captured:
1) Confirm refund/rollover options with FinOps
2) Draft short postmortem in Confluence with onboarding checklist updates
3) Add detection rule for `*_integration` labels + stress-test patterns
I'll ping FinOps and owner the doc link.

Sam (CSM): Thanks team. @Marinex-PM please propose a 30m slot tomorrow to review and go over best practices. Closing loop once spend within 5% of commit. :thumbsup:
